claims.source_quote: The software automates the identification of edentulous segments, abutment teeth, and favorable retentive undercuts at the selected path of insertion.
claims.note: the source states undercut identification and rule-based design generation plainly, without a possibility hedge | Stronger-model review disagrees: The unit is judged on its own words (F2). «نرم‌افزار» carries no pointing word such as «این نرم‌افزار», so it is not read through to AiDENTAL. It is a claim about software in general. F2-ii's HEDGE_ADDED test is to strip the qualifier, and the claim must then be the source's own finding, not wider. Stripped, the unit says software computes undercuts and proposes rule-based designs. That is wider than the source, which states those capabilities for one tool: «The software automates the identification of ... favorable retentive undercuts» and «generates an algorithm-driven custom RPD design based on established design principles». A generalization that keeps the hedge «ممکن است بتواند» is faithful under F2-ii item 1, so the correct verdict is MATCHES, as run 1 found. The next unit («اما مناسب‌بودن این طرح برای بیمار ...») only qualifies the design output and does not tie «نرم‌افزار» to AiDENTAL.

claims.claim_quote: مثلاً ممکن است قالب‌گیری سنتی انجام دهیم، کست گچی را اسکن کنیم و طراحی و ساخت را دیجیتال ادامه دهیم.
claims.source_quote:
In Group I, the analog steps involved taking physical impressions and creating
stone casts followed by scanning the casts with a laboratory scanner to create virtual casts.
claims.note: F1: none of the three lines removes this unit. It is not NOT_A_CLAIM, because it states something about the world: a combined workflow (conventional impression, then scanning the stone cast, then digital design and fabrication) can be done. It is not AUTHOR_VIEW. The first-person plural «انجام دهیم» is not one of the line-2(a) opinion markers. It is not future or prediction, and it gives no explanation of a finding. So it is attributed. F2: «ممکن است» frames the workflow as one option, matching the source's own «Alternatively, for a combined analog-digital workflow, it can be done by scanning the stone cast itself». A hedged generalization of what the source states is MATCHES under F2-ii item 1. The earliest sentence that states the workflow is the abstract's Group I sentence. Its digital design and SLM fabrication are stated in the next sentence («Both groups used 3Shape software for digital design ...»), so nothing in the unit is silent or contradicted.
